issues.detail: Thread TH2 contains 15 messages (M19 to M33), which is below the expected minimum of 16 messages per thread.

Messages M71 and M73 explicitly mention levels/labels ('low, medium, and high engagement'), which violates the anti-leakage rule against using high/medium/low when referring to attributes. Additionally, the forbidden term 'class' is used extensively throughout the text (e.g., M13, M14), although it is used in the context of a school classroom.
